scope: Feature DISTRIBUTION, change REPAIR-001: add setup alias and owned integration repair with saved settings, source-owned migration, truthful native readiness, and update catchup/lock sequencing fixes. Prepare unreleased local build; no publication, personal installation, hook trust bypass or running-session changes.

acceptance.description: vesta setup is an install alias with the same provider discovery, options, ownership checks and optional --warm behavior.

Default repair restores only owned providers from recorded standalone inventory or existing source setup records; explicit selection requires ownership. Missing owned shell/plugin/catalog registration can be restored, repeated repair is safe, and available unowned providers are not added.

Plain repair preserves each provider's saved enabled/disabled warming preferences, custom timers and unrelated settings; repair --warm enables warming options for all selected owned providers while preserving other options, recorded native executable, config and shell paths.

Repair reports actual per-provider effective readiness, suspended reason and Claude/Codex restart requirements. Native Codex trust and global feature disables are preserved; no active warming claim without ready trusted hooks, and no existing owner is killed or retrofitted.

Same-version update repairs drifted owned Codex registration even when release version is unchanged or older; healthy current targets remain honest no-ops. Newer release installation occurs only after outer operation lock release, preserving verified candidate and owned-provider selection.

Foreign or edited ownership, missing providers and path overrides fail before integration writes. Late repair/update failures compensate prior owned registry, preferences, inventory and activation, reporting compensation failures honestly.

Local macOS arm64 build embeds exact pinned runtime/native assets and is usable after build checkout removal without Node/Bun on PATH. New unreleased version has distinct immutable identity from published v0.2.1.
Install/setup/repair preserve discovery, source-owned migration and selected-provider boundaries using native CLI registries and stable retained runtime paths.
Package, native plugin, marketplace, binary and tag identities agree; controlled fixture updates validate digests/platform/version before activation. No publication is performed.
Anonymous HTTPS update transport and provider isolation/ownership protections remain verified with actual compiled CLI and native registry fault injection.
Repaired Codex integration preserves native local owner arguments and permissions without remote overrides.
Packaged native keepalive reaches the exact live conversation through queue-only transient client with actual K and later nonce continuity.
Packaged native resume and switching retain fresh-reply eligibility and native identity/cwd behavior.
Actual installed packaged native warming remains verified in isolated home with retained source, hook, queue and rollout evidence.
Native Codex registration/migration remains reversible and ownership-safe while Claude integration and native trust boundaries are preserved.
Conflicting or unknown live owners skip warming; only owned processes are cleaned up.
Repeatable real E2E retains raw command/registry/rollout/hash evidence, personal-file integrity and owned cleanup. Metadata repair/update tests make zero model calls.
